projects.title: MemoryBreaker
projects.tagline: AI Agent Memory Security Benchmarking Toolkit
projects.description: An open-source toolkit for testing AI agent memory systems against persistent, multi-turn memory poisoning attacks. Simulates multi-turn split-write memory poisoning, compares baseline and guarded experiments, verifies attacks using independent retrieval and canary checks, and generates structured experiment and security reports. Baseline and guarded attack success were both 100%. The configured guard recorded zero interventions, showing it did not prevent this tested attack scenario.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of MemoryBreaker AI Agent Memory Security Toolkit

projects.title: Nova-Notes
projects.tagline: 3D Spatial Knowledge Graph & Animated Note Vault
projects.description: A 3D spatial note-taking application that transforms local folders and knowledge into an interactive visual universe. Features interactive 3D knowledge graph, local folder and file visualisation, procedural planet shaders, animated explorers, auto-save, search, backlinks, and command palette.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Nova-Notes 3D Spatial Knowledge Graph

projects.title: ClubHub
projects.description: A MERN-stack application for managing college clubs, members, meetings and announcements. Features member and club management, meeting and announcement scheduling, REST API with CRUD operations, and a modular backend and database architecture.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of ClubHub College Club Management System
